scope: Seven P1 high-bilateral-coverage discordant CDSs versus the complete original LABG_0021 proteome; seed-specific reciprocal-best-HSP-set checks, not exhaustive pairwise cohort RBH or proven orthology.
comparator_strain_limit: Original JDM1-derived cohort assembly; not the full proteome of an experimentally assayed WCFS1 or L. pentosus construct.
ranking: Maximum single-HSP bit score per locus; retain every exact co-best score tie among all reported HSPs; no identity/coverage filter before ranking.
interpretation: Whether the seed is in a reciprocal co-best set is sequence evidence for this proteome pair only; coverage recorded separately. No enzyme activity or orthogroup assertion.
